title: Founded in Pune
description: Six people, one room and a single mandate: publish what you spend.

title: First water programme
description: Two settlements in Nashik restored nine borewells with village committees holding the budgets.

title: Health portfolio opens
description: The mobile clinic model begins in Kalahandi after a survey found eight settlements more than 15 km from a PHC.

title: Learning centres pilot
description: Eight after-school centres open during school closures and stay open afterwards.

title: Published rate contracts
description: All material procurement moves onto a public rate contract with quarterly reconciliation.

title: Sixty libraries and a hundredth project
description: The hundredth project completes; the library corner programme reaches sixty schools.

title: Six programmes, twelve live projects
description: Programmes are now run as six portfolios with budgets published per project before fundraising opens.
